summary: Regression check after removing Platform.select from styles.payloadJson in app/index.tsx. Verified (a) no 'Platform is not defined' runtime error and no page errors in the browser, (b) app renders cleanly top-to-bottom, (c) payload-preview testID renders the exact 11-key flat JSON with correct default values (radius:3, trackFlight:false, flightIdent:'', showWeather:true, lat:35.584, lon:-80.8685, team1:'NYY', team2:'CAR', tv1:'Shrinking', tv2:'Emily in Paris', tv3:'Ted Lasso'), (d) app/index.tsx no longer imports or references Platform (grep confirmed 0 matches), (e) src/theme.ts exports fonts.mono='SpaceMono' and app/_layout.tsx registers SpaceMono in useFonts. The JSON preview visually uses the mono font as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Only a benign React Native Web warning observed: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — coming from a library (likely LinearGradient/Image on web). Not caused by app code and does not affect device runtime. Safe to ignore for now.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified end-to-end via web preview. Actual BLE flows still require a device build (expected — Expo Go / web can't do BLE). Payload contract remains the flat 11-key ESP32 shape.
rca_of_issue: Root cause was a Platform.select() call inside StyleSheet.create for styles.payloadJson while the Platform module import had been removed (or never re-added) — this threw ReferenceError: Platform is not defined at StyleSheet creation time, which is why the error appeared near the payload preview area. Fix removed the Platform.select and points fontFamily to the already-bundled SpaceMono font via fonts.mono. Verified by grep (no Platform references remain) and by successfully rendering the payload-preview element with the expected JSON at runtime.
